title: Moesha
description:
S4 E6 — I Know What You Did In The Third Grade
Moesha and her friends are stalked by a student who was just released from jail who they haven’t seen since the third grade when he got into trouble because of them.  Parody of Brandy’s feature 'I Still Know What You Did Last Summer…'.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E7 — A Terrible Thing Happened On My Tour Of College
Moesha and her friends are invited to a college to attend a Prospective Freshman Weekend and someone slips a 'roofie' in her drink.  Her boyfriend Aaron keeps her from being taken advantage of.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E8 — Birth Control
Moesha gets birth control pills when she decides she would like to lose her virginity to Aaron.  However, things get complicated when Dee finds the pills in her purse.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E9 — A Class Act Christmas
Moesha, Hakeem, and the other employees of the Class Act are held hostage by a man dressed as Santa Claus protesting age discrimination.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E10 — The Crush
A friend of Myles who has a crush on Moesha pretends he cannot read so she can tutor him.  However, after an article she writes about the success she has had with the little student is published in the LA Times, Moesha learns a hard lesson.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E11 — Barking Up The Wrong Tree
Hakeem accepts a job as assistant manager of the Class Act claiming there are financial difficulties at home. Moesha, concerned about his college education, confronts his mother who denies his claims.

title: Moesha
description:
S4 E12 — Life Imitating Art
Racial tensions mount in Moesha’s high school after a mural depicting Latin American hero Caesar Chavez is purposely defaced.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E9 — Dead Guy
After faking an injury in order to sue Malcolm and Eddie, an unruly customer suddenly dies in the kitchen.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E10 — Do The KC Hustle
An old college rival shows up at the bar looking to avenge a game of pool he lost to Malcolm.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E11 — It's The Bomb
Acting on a rumor that the local football team is moving, a crazed fan takes the bar hostage.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E12 — Sh-boing-boing
After an argument with his wife of 49 years, Malcolm's grandfather arrives to stay with him and Eddie.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E13 — Club Story
Eddie offers to take over at the bar so Malcolm can dine with his girlfriend's wealthy father.

title: Malcolm & Eddie
description:
S1 E14 — Lock Down
Ticket scalping gets Malcolm and Eddie jailed on the eve of Martin Luther King Day.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S1 E14 — Piano Movers
A great deal on a grand piano finds Lamont and Fred lodged in the apartment of a wealthy eccentric.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E1 — The Light Housekeeper
When Fred Sanford receives a slight injury in a car mishap, Lamont finds himself waiting on his father hand and foot. Fred rejects the idea of having Aunt Ethel help him around the house and settles for Lamont's zany plan to hire a housekeeper.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E2 — Blood Is Thicker Than Junk
Lamont seeks employment elsewhere, forcing Fred to find a new partner for the junkyard. The situation becomes intolerable for Fred when he realizes his new partner is long on brawn, but short on brain.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E3 — By The Numbers
Fred gets that old feeling -- not love... the numbers!! He's sure he's dreamed up a winner, but Lamont refuses to let him place a bet. But Fred may not be the only loser.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E4 — Card Sharps
Fred is convinced that Lamont's card-playing buddies are trying to sock it to him for every cent he's got, but Lamont won't believe him. Fred's attempts at signaling Lamont create nothing but constant turmoil.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E5 — Whiplash
After Fred has an accident in the pick-up truck, he decides he is suffering from whiplash. Fred's friend Bubba (Don Bexley) convinces him he is sitting on a gold mine. Lamont, on the other hand, is sure his father is faking.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E6 — Have Gun, Will Sell
Lamont and his friend Rollo (Nathaniel Taylor) scare off a burglar in the Sanford house, but he leaves something behind -- a gun. Rollo convinces Fred and Lamont that they could make some money if they pawn the gun, but the scheme explodes.

title: Sanford and Son
description:
S2 E7 — The Dowry
Fred's cousin and his new bride visit from St. Louis with the idea of finding a husband for his cousin's new stepdaughter. When Fred learns there's a $10,000 dowry involved, he schemes to get Lamont to ask for her hand in marriage.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E14 — The Jefferson Curve
After watching George Jefferson in action, his young protege Marcus bends the truth to win the heart of a young lady and throws a curve that lands Lionel in foul territory.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E15 — 984 W. 124th., Apt. 5c
When Louise discovers that George has been sending presents and money to a mysterious address, she follows him to find out why and is shocked...and touched by what she sees.

title: The Jeffersons
description:
S4 E16 — George And Whitty
George and Louise are stunned by their landlord Whittendale's plans to evict them, but their biggest surprise is yet to come when they invite him down to discuss it.
